title: Voc Eval in Barton Hall, Two Weeks of Butt-Heads, & The Hall Pass Prison
description: Arriving at Barton Hall on a Sunday in March 2007, twenty-one-year-old Katie and Nate endure a creepy first roommate, nasty cafeteria rations, and a two-week Vocational Evaluation where they have to prove they know how to make a bed and do laundry, butt heads with aides who try to grab their wheelchair push-handles and evaluators who demand they split up during social time, and despise begging for Hall Passes just to ride the VATS bus or visit ValueMart.
